summary: Runner tests spawn real LocalRunner/ShellRunner without env_file and reject every nearby violation: token in argv/env fails the no-leak asserts, mounting the host secrets file fails the separate-path asserts, and wrong-privilege delivery fails the write-only snapshot content check; injected-file use is proven end-to-end for shared-client (factory + wire headers), liveness (/live curl carries Bearer via stdin), and shell-library requests (_TASK_LIB and setup-repo executed against curl stubs).
